summary: Son of Bull Smith of Smithtown and John's 9th-great-grand-uncle; ancestor of the Woodhull, Gardiner, Tyler, Bailey and J. Lawrence Smith cousins.
bio:
Richard Smith was a son of Bull Smith, the founder of Smithtown, and his wife Sarah Hammond, and is John's 9th-great-grand-uncle. His eldest son inherited the blunderbuss known in the family as "Old Crib" that had belonged to Richard's mother, Sarah Hammond.

Through his daughter Sarah he was a grandfather of General Nathaniel Woodhull, and through his son Nathaniel a grandfather of Mary Smith Gardiner. His descendants include the Woodhull, Gardiner and Tyler, Bailey and J. Lawrence Smith cousins of John's family.
